countCondition: Per portal present in the relevant player array at every spawning callback, with the entire spawning window running normally. Counts are newly spawned base-wave units, not simultaneously living units.

rule.validSpawnTimes: k * interval, integer k >= 0, k * interval < window

one-shot-helper.fact: TimerStart(..., duration, false, callback) is registered synchronously; callback calls the stored function directly.

immediate-and-periodic-spawn.fact: Ordinary waves register the periodic action and also call it directly once. Ordinary endless uses endlessRate; endless bosses take a distinct early return and are excluded here.

periodic-helper.fact: TriggerRegisterTimerEventPeriodic immediately calls TriggerRegisterTimerEvent(trigger, period, true).

stop-duration.fact: Mainline uses time_of_show[cur_monLv]; ordinary endless uses endlessShow.

one-unit-per-portal.fact: Iterate Player_Index_Arr unless Game_Mode==1 and GAME_ENDLESS_TYPE==2; each entry calls the constructor once; constructor calls CreateUnitAtLoc once.

mainline-interval-array.fact: time_of_show_rate[1..54]. Per-wave value and store lines appear in the data rows.

next-wave-separation.fact: Next mainline start gaps are 50/54/82 seconds (>40); the next start after an ordinary endless wave is 1+14=15 seconds (>14).

endless-capacity-points.fact: All four ordinary endless templates have points=2.

verification.method: Independently interpreted numeric Lua array assignments, compared all 54 rows with prior extracted JSON, and simulated (dueMicroseconds, enqueueSequence) heap including cancellation and each periodic re-enqueue. Also compared to exact integer ceiling formula. This checks the specification, not a built game.

actualCompletedCount: portal removed from the relevant player array
game or wave execution ends early
remainingVariables.notAQuantityVariable: Ordinary endless template randomization changes the unit identity, not the one-unit-per-batch count.
remainingVariables.nativeClient: The actual Warcraft client ordering at equal timestamps remains unverified. This Web result must not overwrite the original native bounds.
